question.problem:
Consider the following arithmetic sequence.

$$
-22,\,-31,\,-40,\,-49,\,…
$$

The common difference of this arithmetic sequence is{{field-1}}.

current_example.problem:
What is the common difference of the following arithmetic sequence?

$$
7,\: 2,\: -3,\: -8,\: \ldots
$$
current_example.worked_solution:
The common difference $d$ of an arithmetic sequence is the difference between any two consecutive terms.

Therefore, the common difference for our sequence is

$$
\begin{aligned}d & ={a}_{2}-{a}_{1} \\  & =2-7 \\  & =-5.\end{aligned}
$$
